    int x, y, n, a = 0, b = 1;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

        long long current = abs((long long)x * i * b - (long long)a * i * y);

        int t1 = (double)x * i / y;
        int t2 = t1 + 1;

        long long diff1 = abs((long long)t1 * b * y - (long long)x * i * b);
        long long diff2 = abs((long long)t2 * b * y - (long long)x * i * b);

        if (diff1 < current)
            current = diff1, a = t1, b = i;
        if (diff2 < current)
            current = diff2, a = t2, b = i;
    }
    cout << a << "/" << b;
    return 0;
}
